seatedToss.guidance: Hlala etafileni uze uthathe amaxesha ukuphosa ingxowa yembotyi ethambileyo kwisikhombo esikhulu. Gcina amanani ephepheni, ndawonye.
steps: Printa isikhombo nephepha lamanani, uze uyibeke phansi etafileni phakathi kwenu.
Hlalani ngokuzolileyo, omnye ecaleni elinye. Thathani amaxesha, ngophosa olunye oluthambileyo ngumntu ngamnye, okanye dlula ukuba ungathanda.
Xa iphosa lifika kwesangqa, lowo uphoseleyo utshixa ibhokisi enye kwikholom yakhe, kumgca wesangqa leso.
Jonganani iitshikhi ndawonye xa nisima, ukuba nifuna. Akukho mntu unyanzelekileyo ukubala nantoni na.
Yima nanini na xa nawuphi na umntu elungele ukuyeka.
seatedToss.safetyLine: Sebenzisa ingxowa enesigqubuthelo esidityaniswe ngomnwe okanye isokisi eqengqiweyo kuphela, hlala phantsi, ungaphoseli ebusweni, kwaye ugcine umntu omdala akufuphi. Izinto ezincinci ziyingozi yokuthintela umphefumlo.
flags: Akulungele abantu abangaphantsi kwe-3: izinto ezincinci
safety: Khetha ingxowa yembotyi enesigqubuthelo esidityaniswe ngomnwe, okanye qengqa isokisi ecocekileyo. Yihlole kuqala ukuze ingabikho mingxunya okanye mithungo ekhululekileyo, ukuze nto yangaphakathi ingaphumi.
Iimbotyi, irayisi kunye nezinye izinto ezincinci ziyingozi yokuthintela umphefumlo. Zigcine kude nabantwana abancinci nakubo bonke abafaka izinto emlonyeni.
Hlala ngaphakathi kobude bengalo uze ujonge ngokucokisekileyo ukuba kukho nto inokufakwa emlonyeni.
Hlala phantsi. Phosa ngobunono nangezantsi kwisikhombo setafile, ungaze uphose ebusweni.
seatedToss.previewLabel: Iphepha eliprintiweyo: isikhombo esinemisesane emithathu ebizwa ngokuthi Kufuphi, Phakathi noKude, ukusuka ngaphandle ukuya ngaphakathi, kunye nephepha lamanani elinekholom yomntu ngamnye nomgca weebhokisi ezingenanto kwisangqa ngasinye.
seatedToss.sheetHow: Beka iphepha liphanzi phakathi kwenu. Xa iphosa lifika kwisangqa, tshixa ibhokisi kwikholom yakho, kumgca walo sangqa.

steps: Printa wonke amaphepha. Iphepha lokuqala ngamanyathelo nemephu yodonga.
Umntu ngamnye uthatha iphepha elinye okanye ngaphezulu aze alipeyinte.
Imibala neendlela zokupeyinta azifuni kuhambelana. Wonke amaphepha ayinxalenye yomfanekiso omnye.
Beka amaphepha ngokwamaleyibhile, uze uwadibanise ngeteyipu ngasemva.
Mise udonga apho wonke umntu anokulibona khona.

conversationCards.guidance: Funda ikhadi ngokuvakalayo. Akukho mpendulo echanekileyo.
conversationCards.groupSit: Hlalani emjikelezweni apho wonke umntu enokuwubona khona umfanekiso. Umntu ophethe ikhadi, okanye isixhobo esinomfanekiso omkhulu, ufunde isikhuthazo ngelizwi elikhulu kuqala.
conversationCards.groupPass: Emva koko dlulisani ikhadi komnye umntu. Wonke umntu athethe igama okanye isivakalisi malunga nomfanekiso, emva koko alidlulisele komnye.
conversationCards.groupNoSpeech: Ukudlulisa ikhadi kuvunyelwe ngalo lonke ixesha. Umntu unokudlulisa engathethanga nto, akukho namnye ofuneka ukuchaza isizathu.
conversationCards.groupEnd: Umjikelo uphela xa ikhadi lijikeleze umjikelo wonke, okanye xa iqela lanelisekile. Akukho mntu ophumelelayo. Yimani nanini na xa iqela lifuna ukuyima.

photoPairs.guidance: Cofa ifoto, uze ucofe leyo ifana nayo.
photoPairs.intro: **Khetha iifoto ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-6** kwesi sixhobo. Ziboniswa kuphela kweli phepha kwaye azize zilayishwe okanye zigcinwe ndawo.
photoPairs.empty: Iifoto zakho zizakuvela apha, nganye kabini.

pictureBingo.guidance: Qala ngokushicilela amakhadi. Emva koko bonisa lo mbizi kwesona sikrini sikhulu onaso.

calmBreathing.guidance: Phefumlela ngaphakathi njengoko isangqa sikhula, uze uphefumlele ngaphandle njengoko sincipha. Sima ngokwaso emva kokuphefumla kathandathu.
calmBreathing.started: Kuqalisiwe. Phefumlela ngaphakathi njengoko isangqa sikhula.
calmBreathing.finished: Kube kukuphefumla kancinci kathandathu oko. Ungaphinda uqale nanini na uthanda.

storyChain.guidance: Jikanani: isivakalisi esinye ngomntu nomntu, yongezani umfanekiso olandelayo.
storyChain.passNote: Thethani isivakalisi senu ngezwi eliphezulu. Akukho nto ibhalwayo okanye egcinwayo. Nabani na unokudlula.
storyChain.full: Uchungechunge lunayo yonke imifanekiso esibhozo. Xelelani le ntsomi iyonke, okanye qalani uchungechunge olutsha.
